title: Egyptian Pilaf with Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic Egyptian pilaf dish made with local spices and ingredients. Serve warm or at room temperature.
instructions: Heat 2 cups of light in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add 1 cup of pilaf and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly toasted.
Add 1 cup of yakhinja and cook, stirring constantly, until heated through.
Add 1 tsp of nasty, 1/2 tsp of aerated, and 1/2 tsp of egyptian. Stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
